lastCompletedStory.title: Planner agent: drop journal.md and integral patterns.md from Project Context, remove AGENTS.md refs

nextStoryContext: US-004 (reviewer agent) only needs the lessons.archive.md citation re-pointed to the durable invariants block in scripts/cam/CLAUDE.md; per its notes, that citation exists only in .claude/agents/subagent-reviewer.md (~line 77), the templates copy likely needs no edit (verify with grep first). Do not introduce a patterns.md/journal.md full-read mandate into either reviewer copy — they correctly don't have one today, and the acceptance criteria explicitly forbid adding one. Do not touch subagent-auditor.md, and do not remove the AGENTS.md reference in templates/agents/subagent-reviewer.md ~line 100 (that removal is scoped to planner + implementer only, not reviewer, per this issue's spec). Also out of scope: the reviewer's read-changed-files-in-full posture (separate issue).
